vision: Pass all six evaluation gates on a stratified n=20 run with Claude Sonnet 4.6, using forensics-driven iteration — not projected subset scores. iter-2a (16K diff) and iter-2b (SPECULATIVE rubric) are promising but unvalidated on a combined sample. The real blockers are D1 (clean false positives) and D3 (buggy diagnosis at the gate floor). Wrong-mechanism failures (37.5% of low-D3 buggy commits) are unlikely to yield to prompt tweaks alone; smart diff assembly and judge-infra fixes are higher-leverage next bets than multi-turn or model swaps.
direction: Validate → measure → branch. (1) Combined n=5 smoke on iter-2a+b. (2) n=20 confirmation — the iteration gate. (3) Only if a dimension fails: apply the smallest targeted fix mapped to forensics tags (smart diff for truncation survivors, rubric round-2 for clean FPs, hypothesis-ranking prompt for wrong-mechanism, judge fallback for empty JIRA). Cut EXP-MULTITURN-AB and cost optimization until n=20 passes. EXP-JUDGE-SWAP runs in parallel for n=50 confidence, not as a blocker to n=20. n=50 remains the delivery-confidence gate per docs/evaluation.md.

what_we_can_control: Diff presentation: char limit, per-file prioritization, truncation metadata surfaced to agent
Investigation prompt: SUPPORTED/SPECULATIVE tiers, hypothesis count, wrong-mechanism anti-anchoring rules
Context bundle: file histories (already collected but not injected into prompt), test files, blame snippets
Judge model and rubric: cross-model judge, fix-diff-only fallback when JIRA description empty
Multi-turn and model tier (expensive, weak forensic evidence — last resort)
what_we_cannot_control: Ground truth ambiguity: clean commits that contain plausible defect patterns (3/6 FPs may be irreducible without runtime/test evidence)
Same-commit analysis ceiling: agent cannot know if a 'bug-like' pattern was actually exercised in production
ApacheJIT JIRA quality: empty descriptions make D3 unscorable (f897d46870ba — judge-infra, not agent failure)
Wrong-mechanism when agent has full diff: agent finds A real bug, not THE bug (409664582f53) — requires domain oracle or fix-commit visibility
Statistical noise: n=20 gate has ~±0.10 confidence interval on D1/D3 — a pass/fail can flip on sample luck
Judge variance: LLM-as-judge D3/D5 scores drift ±0.25 per commit

minimum_path_to_six_gates_n20.summary: iter-2a+b may already suffice if projections hold. If not, one more targeted iteration (2c or 2d) before expensive experiments.

by_dimension.D1: Need 14/20 correct (iter-1: 12/20). iter-2b fixes ~3 clean FPs → projected 15/20 (0.75). Floor risk: 3 stubborn clean FPs with genuinely SUPPORTED-looking mechanisms. Fallback: require ≥2 independent SUPPORTED hypotheses OR downgrade corrective-commit patterns.
by_dimension.D2: At gate floor (0.15). Clean stratum scores 0.00 — not a current blocker. Monitor for regression; defer dedicated D2 work unless n=20 fails here.
by_dimension.D3: At gate floor (0.20). Six buggy commits at D3=0.0 dominate. iter-2a lifts fbf0ffad627b (0→0.75). 572f3cee35fe unchanged at 16K — needs smart diff, not more chars. Exclude judge-infra commit from D3 aggregate or apply fix-diff fallback (+0.02 lift). Wrong-mechanism (3 commits) unlikely fixed by prompt alone.
by_dimension.D5: Passing (0.37). No action unless iter-2 prompt changes regress.
by_dimension.D6: Strong (0.85). Hard regression guard ≥0.70 on every change.

minimum_path_to_six_gates_n20.estimated_cost_to_gate: ~$0.15 (n=5 validate + n=20 confirm). +~$0.05 if iter-2c/2d needed. Total <$0.25 before declaring n=20 pass.

keep.EXP-JUDGE-SWAP: Low cost (~$0.02), high value for n=50 delivery claim. Run in parallel with n=20 — does NOT block iteration gate.
keep.EXP-BUNDLE-EXPAND: Repurpose: run ONLY on n=20 failure subset (90846b architectural-depth, 572f3cee if smart diff fails). Not a blind n=5 experiment.
keep.EXP-HARD-SUBSET-MODEL: Keep as contingency if wrong-mechanism + truncation fixes exhaust prompt/context options on ≥3 hard commits.

cut_or_defer.EXP-MULTITURN-AB: CUT. Zero forensic evidence. Multi-turn adds cost/latency without addressing identified failure modes. Revisit only if smart diff + rubric round-2 fail AND agent explicitly sets follow_up_needed on hard commits.
cut_or_defer.EXP-COST-MODEL-MATRIX: DEFER until n=20 gates pass. Optimizing cost of a failing system is waste.
cut_or_defer.iter-2-n50: DEFER until n=20 passes AND EXP-JUDGE-SWAP clears same-model bias concern.

add.iter-2c-smart-diff: Per-file diff assembly: ensure each touched file has ≥1 hunk visible before global truncation. Addresses 572f3cee35fe (16K linear truncation hides XmppGroupChatProducer.java).
add.iter-2d-wrong-mechanism: Prompt: require hypothesis coverage of ALL production files in touched_files; rank by diff delta size; forbid anchoring on first interesting pattern.
add.FIX-JUDGE-INFRA: D3 fallback when JIRA description empty: score against fix-commit message + fix diff only. Prevents f897d46870ba from anchoring D3 at 0.
add.REGRESSION-PANEL: Fixed 12-commit panel (6 known buggy + 6 known clean FPs) for fast iteration instead of random n=5 smoke.

strategy_assessment.n20_vs_n50_tension: docs/evaluation.md defines delivery gate at n≥50. Current iteration uses n=20 as a fast gate with acceptance thresholds held constant. Honest stance: n=20 pass = 'ready for n=50 confirmation'; n=20 fail = 'keep iterating'. Do not declare V1 delivery on n=20 alone.
